work.author: Anglican-Roman Catholic International Commission
work.description: The fifth agreed statement of the second phase of the Anglican-Roman Catholic International Commission, signed at Seattle on 2 February 2004 by the co-chairmen Alexander J. Brunett and Peter F. Carnley and published in 2005. The document's own status paragraph states that it is a joint statement of the Commission and is not an authoritative declaration by the Roman Catholic Church or by the Anglican Communion. Loci are the numbered paragraphs.
work.title: Mary: Grace and Hope in Christ
